input.subject: Re: How do I export a project to CSV?
input.body:
Hi Priya,

Yes, you can export all tasks in a project to a spreadsheet. Open the project, choose the "..." menu, then Export > CSV. The export includes all tasks, assignees and due dates.

More details: https://help.brightline.example/export-csv

Let us know if you need anything else.

Brightline Support
